title: Hot water supply temperature maintenance.
officialText: Where the developed length of hot or tempered water piping from the source of hot water supply to the farthest fixture exceeds 20 feet (6096 mm), the hot water supply system shall be provided with a method of maintaining the temperature in accordance with the New York City Energy Conservation Code.
